question: What bodily afflictions are removed by this wheel-based contemplation?
premises: The practitioner becomes freed from wrinkles and grey hair.
The state is devoid of all diseases.
These are results of the contemplation.
inference: This contemplation removes signs of aging and all diseases.
uncertainties: The gender/case agreement between the two compounds is not fully explicit in isolation.
plain_english: One becomes freed from wrinkles and grey hair, and devoid of all diseases.
